description: At each stage of a bounded ordinal listing, select from the elements missing from the entire earlier history, or return an external marker when none remain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.choiceListingRule.{u} {α : Type u} (h : Ordinal.{u}) (s : (B : Set α) → B.Nonempty → α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RecursionRule h.ToType (Option α)
